summary: Verified remediation of stack trace disclosure and reinforced separation between sanitized client error envelopes and redacted backend structured telemetry.
evidence: Traced the error lifecycle from service layer through route handler to pure ASGI middleware / exception handler, ensuring safe 500 error envelope dispatch.
Verified separation of concerns: client receives only sanitized code, message, and request_id, while diagnostics, exception types, and timings are stored in backend logs.
Confirmed secret redaction mechanics via redact_data and redact_text replacing sensitive tokens, auth headers, and sentinels with [REDACTED].
Full regression verification: all 41 test cases in pytest passed.
